known_outcome: The Board varies the decision of the local authority.; It is the determination of the Board that the side of the new building (i.e. the outside edge of the RV shelter posts) facing the existing RV shelter is an exposing building face and that the spatial separation requirements outlined in Subsection 9.10.14., Division B, apply. In this case, the roof over the deck is considered to be a combustible projection located more than 1 m above the ground.
